name: The Shopkeeper's Hidden List
description: A handwritten note from the quarantined town.
readingText:
Not for the official inventory

Apartment 11 — Extra bread. Girl lives alone.

Apartment 23 — Two tins. Father hasn't returned from factory.

Apartment 34 — No answer for four days.

Hospital — Three boxes of biscuits. Deliver after closing.

Elena — Medicine missing from shipment. Ask Pavel again.

Someone has been taking food from the storage room at night.

I changed the lock yesterday.

This morning, another tin was gone.

The door was still locked.
